title: Assessment of Mental Health and Well-being of Police and Auxiliary Police Officers Who Bear Arms
what_it_is: Assessment of Mental Health and Well-being of Police and Auxiliary Police Officers Who Bear Arms

sections.label: Home Team officer deaths
sections.summary: Between January 2018 and September 2022, 74 uniformed Home Team officers died in service, with three possible suicide cases pending coronial investigations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Between January 2018 and September 2022, 74 uniformed officers in the Home Team passed away while in service.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The cause of death for three others, which had elements to suggest possible suicide, are pending coronial investigations.

sections.label: Police counselling and careers
sections.summary: The Police do not track officers seeking counselling or para-counselling, and those who seek help are not specifically disadvantaged in their careers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Police do not track the number of officers who have sought counselling or para-counselling assistance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Officers who seek help are not specifically disadvantaged in their career because they had sought help.

sections.label: MHA staff suicide rate
sections.summary: MHA staff suicide rate is about half the Singapore national average, with resilience training and toolkits helping supervisors identify distressed officers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Every suicide is one too many and I do not wish to trivialise the situation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But our statistics show that the suicide rate among the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) staff is about half that of the Singapore national average.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In my earlier reply, I had talked about the resilience training, which is conducted for ground officers across the Home Team departments.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There are also simplified and easy to use toolkits which will help supervisors identify officers who are in distress.

sections.label: Staff feedback surveys
sections.summary: Surveys are conducted at regular junctures to collect staff feedback.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the first point, I had mentioned in my earlier reply that we do conduct surveys to collect staff feedback at regular junctures.

sections.label: Geo-fencing privacy balance
sections.summary: The suggestion of geo-fencing can be considered, but the need for privacy and the needs of the job must be balanced.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the second point the Member mentioned about geo-fencing, we can have a think about it, but I think we do have to balance the need for privacy as well as the needs of the job, but we thank the Member very much for that suggestion.
